author: Komorebi P.
new_claims: Surjective initial actual reduced Jacobian produces an infinite compatible integer polynomial tower
Reduced Jacobian is exactly constant along the tower
Compatible integer tower converges in the actual p-adic integers and retains every prescribed precision
Original polynomial evaluation is exactly zero at the constructed limit
Every selected smooth tower stage has exactly p^(d-e) next-level residue lifts and a one-element obstruction group

scope.polynomials: Arbitrary finite lists F in Z[X_1,...,X_d]^e, zero dimensions allowed
scope.jacobian: One initial surjectivity hypothesis on the actual map DF(x) modulo q
scope.padic_root: Prime p; a in Z_p^d, F(a)=0, a=x modulo p^L
scope.tower: z0=x, roots modulo p^(L+n), adjacent compatibility modulo p^(L+n), z_n tends to a
scope.error: a-z_n divisible by p^(L+n); not exact valuation equality
scope.branching: p^(d-e) distinct next-level residue lifts at each selected stage; no multi-level count asserted
scope.uniqueness: Only the limit of a fixed compatible sequence is asserted unique

new_modules.note: Includes support lemmas and boundary controls, not independent discoveries.

independent_reconciliation.scope: Independent evidence reconciliation, not an independent kernel implementation

preserved_results: Full stated Nishibuchi conjecture, sharp towers, exact dyadic periods and isometries, affine/shared and fixed-presentation polynomial obstruction/torsor/count results preserved with previous evidence.
controls: X^2-5 has lower roots mod2 and mod4 but none mod8 or through every level
Surjective rectangular projection has distinct dyadic roots in one lower residue
Nonsingular X-2 cannot retain an unjustified extra binary digit
remaining: Formal uniqueness in the square nonsingular case
Rectangular local parametrization and general singular tower criteria
Unrestricted native13.2/13.3 objects, presentation invariance and descent
Exact higher differences, other least periods, general Mahler-kernel and arbitrary-row tail valuations
not_claimed: Automatic infinite lifting from one successful singular step
Uniqueness among all polynomial roots with a merely surjective rectangular Jacobian
Joint lifting from separately surjective blocks without combined compatibility
A rewritten unified manuscript or external novelty
archive_scope: Known local Paper IX work and all previous cumulative archives by file hash, plus the newly checked tower/root block
